RAG looks solved in a demo and breaks the moment someone asks a multi-table question. The gap between the two is an eval set, guardrails, and an architecture where each failure has an obvious owner.

## Split retrieval from generation

\<Why one mega-prompt is undebuggable; separating grounding from NL2SQL makes each testable.\>

## Guardrails beat cleverness

\<Schema-constrained, read-only SQL trades flexibility for trust.\>

## You need an eval set before you ship

\<Fixed question set, graded on accuracy + SQL validity, run on every change.\>
